caption: The drawing depicts a painted figure of a soldier standing upright on a round, decorated pedestal. The soldier wears a tall black hat with a slight peak and is dressed in a dark blue or black coat with a high collar and red trim down the front, along with brass or gold-colored buttons. The pants are tan or beige with a red stripe running down the side, and the figure is wearing tall black boots. The soldier's left arm is down by their side while the right arm is raised, holding a curved sword or sabre pointed upward; the hand guarding the sword hilt is gold or brass-colored. The face is light brown with visible features and a neutral expression. The pedestal is primarily red and gold or yellow, adorned with a pattern of triangles. The background is a plain, beige paper with some minor speckling and a faint rectangular border around the main subject.
title: Revolutionary Soldier
